Load IDAT Files, Run Quality Control, and Create a MethQcSet

Source: R/MethQcSet-io.R
runMethQC.Rd

Factory function that reads IDAT files for all samples in meta, extracts normalized beta values and detection p-values via minfi, constructs a MethQcSet object, and computes QC metrics. Returns a fully populated MethQcSet.

Usage

runMethQC(
  meta,
  platform = NA,
  pcutoff = 0.05,
  normalization = c("noob", "noob_swan", "raw"),
  save_qc_report = TRUE,
  plot_types = c("intensity", "detection_pval", "probe_coverage", "beta_density"),
  outdir = ".",
  prefix = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

meta

A data.frame with columns:

Sample_Name

Sample identifiers (required)

Basename

IDAT file path prefix, e.g. /path/to/idats/Sentrix_ID (required). Files Sentrix_ID_Red.idat and Sentrix_ID_Grn.idat must exist at that path.

Platform

(optional) Platform string. Used by platform resolution when platform = NA.

platform

Platform string ("EPIC", "EPICv2", "450K") or NA (default). Resolution rules:

NA + Platform column in meta with one unique value

Auto-use that value. Run check_platform(meta) first to populate this column.

NA + Platform column in meta with multiple values

Error with instructions to subset meta by platform and re-call.

NA + no Platform column in meta

Error with instructions to run check_platform(meta) first.

Explicit string (e.g. "EPIC")

Use provided value; any existing Platform column in meta is ignored.

pcutoff

Detection p-value threshold for Final.QC (default 0.05): at least 95% of probes must be detected at p < pcutoff.

normalization

Beta-value normalization:

  • "noob" (default): background and dye-bias correction (minfi::preprocessNoob(dyeMethod = "single"));

  • "noob_swan": noob followed by SWAN, which adjusts Infinium type I/II differences (minfi::preprocessSWAN(), run with a fixed seed so results are reproducible);

  • "raw": unnormalized beta (minfi::preprocessRaw()), the behaviour of earlier package versions.

save_qc_report

Logical. If TRUE, write package-native QC plot PDFs and density-report PDFs. Default: TRUE.

plot_types

Character vector or comma-separated string of package-native QC plot types to write when save_qc_report = TRUE. The default is c("intensity", "detection_pval", "probe_coverage", "beta_density"); beta density writes all, PASS, and FAIL sample PDFs. Use NULL, character(0), or "none" to skip package-native QC plot PDFs.

outdir

Directory for QC plot/report PDFs. Default: ".".

prefix

Filename prefix for QC plot/report PDFs. If NULL, the resolved platform name is used.

...

Additional arguments passed to minfi::read.metharray.exp().

Value

A MethQcSet object with:

  • beta slot populated from minfi::getBeta() after normalization

  • detection_pval slot populated from minfi::detectionP()

  • qc_tables slot populated with QC metrics

  • platform slot set to the resolved platform string

  • qc_params slot recording normalization and the minfi array_annotation

Details

Beta values are normalized with normalization; all three methods work on 450K, EPIC and EPICv2 arrays and normalize each sample on its own, so a sample's beta values do not depend on which other samples are in the cohort. Detection p-values, probe intensities and predicted sex are always computed from the unnormalized data. The method is recorded in qc_params(x)$normalization. Normalization changes beta values and hence IDS, so compare cohorts, and build reference profiles (BuildReferenceProfile()), with the same method.

EPICv2 arrays are not recognized by minfi releases before Bioconductor 3.19; for platform "EPICv2" (or an unrecognized array with more than 1.1 million probes) the minfi annotation is set to IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2 / 20a1.hg38. This requires the IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2manifest and IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2anno.20a1.hg38 packages.

Final.QC in qc_tables(x)$QC_matrix is "PASS" when at least 95% of probes are detected at p < pcutoff (default 0.05) and, when the control-probe metrics could be computed, CtrlMetrics.QC is "PASS". CtrlMetrics.QC is "FAIL" only when Bisulfite Conversion I Green or Red falls below its threshold (1). The other control metrics are reported in qc_tables(x)$ctrl_metrics but do not fail a sample.

The control-probe metrics (Illumina BeadArray Controls Reporter), SNP genotype calls, sample-swap check (contamination: sample pairs whose genotype agreement contradicts Donor_ID, or Sample_Name when absent) and predicted donors follow the ewastools methods (Heiss and Just, 2018) and give the same results as ewastools 1.8.2; ewastools itself is not needed.

See also

check_platform() to detect and annotate platforms before calling this function; MethQcSet for the returned object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Case 1: Known single-platform cohort
meta <- read.table("meta.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
qcset <- runMethQC(meta, platform = "EPIC")

# Default QC plot/report PDFs:
#   epic_QC_detection_pval.pdf, epic_QC_probe_coverage.pdf
#   epic_QC_minfiDensity_all.pdf
#   plots/epic_QC_intensity.pdf
#   plots/epic_QC_betaDensity_all/pass/fail.pdf
#   plots/epic_QC_minfiDensity_pass/fail.pdf
qcset <- runMethQC(meta, platform = "EPIC",
                   outdir = "qc_output",
                   prefix = "epic")

# Case 2: Platform unknown - detect first, then run QC
meta <- check_platform(meta)
table(meta$Platform)  # inspect

meta_epic <- meta[meta$Platform == "EPIC", ]
qcset_epic <- runMethQC(meta_epic)  # platform auto-resolved from meta$Platform

meta_450k <- meta[meta$Platform == "450K", ]
qcset_450k <- runMethQC(meta_450k)
} # }
